approval.text:
flowchart TD
  n1(["Start"])
  n2["Review the request carefully before anything else"]
  n3{"Approved?"}
  n4["Ship it"]
  n5[/"Send back"/]
  n6>"Remember to log every step in the tracker"]
  n7(("End"))
  n8["A comment"]
  n1 --> n2
  n2 --> n3
  n3 -->|"Yes"| n4
  n3 -.->|"No"| n5
  n5 <--> n2
  n4 --- n7
  n6 -->|"a very long connector label that goes on and on and on past the cap"| n8
  classDef green fill:#e5f5ea,stroke:#86c79c
  class n4 green
  classDef pink fill:#fce8ee,stroke:#eba3b8
  class n5 pink
  classDef purple fill:#efe9fb,stroke:#b6a1e6
  class n7 purple
  classDef accent fill:#f1f1f3,stroke:#8e8e96
  class n8 accent

sideways.text:
flowchart LR
  n1["One"]
  n2["Two"]
  n3{"Three?"}
  n4(["Four"])
  n5["Five"]
  n1 --> n2
  n2 --> n3
  n3 -->|"ok"| n4
  n3 --> n5
  n5 -.-> n1
